name: Elder Shadow Dragon
tactics: A shadow dragon never fights fair. It lurks in the darkness, biding its time for the proper moment to strike. In fact, a shadow dragon might follow its quarry for hours before revealing itself. When it finally strikes, it drops globes of darkness, then uses shadow walk to move to the best position for its breath weapon, spending an action point to use it on that turn. While its foes struggle against the rotting power of that attack, the dragon tears into them with fangs and claws, spawning additional globes of darkness to help it teleport about the battlefield.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

weaknesses.name: Radiant
weaknesses.details: (whenever a shadow dragon takes radiant damage, one of its globes of darkness ends)

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Combat Advantage
traits.details: The shadow dragon deals 4d6 extra damage against a target it has combat advantage against.

hit.description: damage, and the target is weakened (save ends)

effect.description: The dragon makes a bite attack and a claw attack.

powers.name: Tail Slash
powers.trigger: when an enemy misses the dragon with a melee attack
powers.flavorText: The dragon uses its tail to attack the target

powers.name: Breath Weapon
powers.description: The target’s necrotic resistance is negated until the end of the encounter.

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the target loses one healing surge and is weakened (save ends).

aftereffects.name: Aftereffect
aftereffects.description: The target’s necrotic resistance is negated until the end of the encounter.

miss.description: Half damage, and the target does not lose a healing surge

effect.description: The dragon’s breath weapon recharges, and the dragon uses it immediately.

powers.name: Frightful Presence
powers.description: The target takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls (save ends)

hit.description: the target is stunned until the end of the dragon’s next turn.

aftereffects.name: Aftereffect
aftereffects.description: The target takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls (save ends)

effect.description: this power creates a zone of darkness that remains in place until the end of the dragon’s next turn. The zone blocks line of sight for all creatures except the dragon. Any creature entirely within the area (except the dragon) is blinded.

A shadow dragon that is in at least one square of a globe of darkness can teleport to any other globe of darkness within line of sight. It must end this move in at least one square of that globe of darkness.
